title: 第1308章 战战战第1307章 第一重天的最终决战
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
何平安的嘴角，微微勾起了一抹弧度。
那一抹弧度，很淡。
可就是这一抹淡淡的弧度，却让所有看到它的人心中同时升起了一股寒意。
他又想搞什么？
下一刻，何平安缓缓抬起了手中的木剑。
“诸位师弟师妹。”
“可愿随我，破阵杀敌？”
一万亿人界弟子同时一愣，随后，便是滔天的战意。
“愿！”
“愿随师兄！”
“战！战！战！”
一万亿人界弟子的战意再次被点燃，他们的眼中翻涌着疯狂的光芒！
何平安深吸一口气，那双清澈的眼眸中闪过一丝决然。
“天道战阵......”
“爆！”
轰！！！
那一瞬间，整座第一重天战场都仿佛静止了！
天道战阵的青光在一瞬间膨胀到了极致，然后轰然炸裂！
那股恐怖到极点的爆炸之力，朝着四面八方疯狂席卷而去！
万魔噬天大阵，破！

万妖屠天阵，破！
审判之阵，破！
噬魂大阵，破！
远古战场上，死一般的寂静。
所有的观战者全都瞪大了眼睛，呆呆地看着光幕中那震撼到极点的一幕。
自爆战阵？
那小子，竟然自爆了战阵？
没了战阵，如何对抗三百五十万亿大军？
他想干什么？
因为战阵一旦自爆，就意味着放弃了最大的倚仗，意味着将自家的弟子彻底暴露在了敌人的屠刀之下！
这是自杀！
是彻彻底底的自杀！
“他疯了！他一定是疯了！”
魔界阵营中，一位禁忌魔王失声惊呼。
“自爆战阵？他难道不知道没有了战阵的庇护，他们那点人根本不够四界联军塞牙缝的吗？”
妖界阵营中，金色巨龙的眼中也闪过一丝不解。
“这小子......到底在想什么？”
鬼界的三尊禁忌鬼王互相对视一眼，同时看出了对方眼中的疑惑。
神族四大主神更是面面相觑，完全搞不懂何平安的用意。
人界阵营中，血月老祖的脸色瞬间变得惨白如纸。

“自爆战阵？他......他这是要干什么！”
黄金族老祖也是面色大变，声音中满是压抑不住的颤抖。
“没有了战阵，人界弟子拿什么去对抗四界联军？”
冰神那双冰蓝色的美目中却闪过一丝异样的光芒。
“不对......你们看他的眼睛。”
content_en:
The corners of He Pingan's mouth curved slightly.
That arc is very light.
But just this faint arc caused a chill to rise in the hearts of everyone who saw it.
What does he want to do?
The next moment, He Pingan slowly raised the wooden sword in his hand.
"Junior brothers and sisters."
"Would you like to follow me and break the formation and kill the enemy?"
One trillion disciples in the human world were stunned at the same time, and then there was overwhelming fighting spirit.
"Wish!"
"I would like to follow my senior brother!"
"Fight! Fight! Fight!"
The fighting spirit of the one trillion human world disciples was once again ignited, and their eyes were filled with crazy light!
He Pingan took a deep breath, and a trace of determination flashed in his clear eyes.
"Tiandao Battle Formation..."
"Explode!"
Boom! ! !
At that moment, the entire first-level battlefield seemed to have stopped!
The green light of the Tiandao Battle Formation expanded to the extreme in an instant, and then exploded!
That terrifying explosion force swept crazily in all directions!
The Ten Thousand Demons Devouring Heaven Formation is broken!
The Ten Thousand Demons Slaying Heaven Formation is broken!
The judgment formation is broken!
The soul-eating formation is broken!
On the ancient battlefield, there was deathly silence.
All the spectators stared blankly at the shocking scene in the light curtain.
Self-destruction battle array?
That kid actually blew himself up in the battle formation?
Without battle formations, how can we fight against an army of 350 trillion?
What does he want to do?
Because once the battle formation self-destructs, it means giving up the greatest reliance, and it means completely exposing one's disciples to the enemy's butcher's knife!
This is suicide!
It's a complete suicide!
"He's crazy! He must be crazy!"
In the demon camp, a forbidden demon king cried out in surprise.
"Self-destruction of the battle formation? Doesn't he know that without the protection of the battle formation, their few people are not enough to fill the gap between the Four Realms Allied Forces?"
In the demon world camp, a trace of confusion flashed in the eyes of the golden dragon.
"What on earth is this kid thinking?"
The three forbidden ghost kings of the ghost world looked at each other and saw the confusion in each other's eyes.
The four main gods of the Protoss looked at each other in confusion, completely confused about He Ping'an's intentions.
In the human world camp, the Blood Moon Ancestor's face instantly turned as pale as paper.
"Self-destruction of the battle formation? He...what is he going to do!"
The expression of the ancestor of the Golden Tribe also changed drastically, and his voice was filled with uncontrollable trembling.
"Without the battle formation, what can the disciples of the human world do to fight against the coalition forces of the four realms?"
A strange light flashed in the ice-blue beautiful eyes of the Ice God.
"No... look into his eyes."
